pages.title: Privacy Policy | RC Car King
pages.heading: Privacy Policy
pages.description: How RC Car King handles optional Google Analytics, cookie choices, hosting requests, Google Fonts, Amazon affiliate links and messages.
pages.intro: This policy explains the data involved when you visit RC Car King. The publication is run by Aleksandar Spasevski. It describes the current research-led review website and the external services it uses.

sections.heading: Information involved in a visit
paragraphs: You can read our reviews without an account. RC Car King currently has no registration, newsletter signup, comments, payment form or checkout. Optional Google Analytics runs only after you accept analytics cookies. We store your accept or reject choice in browser local storage for up to 180 days; you can change it using Cookie settings in the footer.

Like other websites, delivering a page involves request information such as your IP address, requested URL, browser information and the time of the request. Our hosting and security provider, Cloudflare, processes request data to deliver the site, detect abuse and maintain its services. Request headers may include a referring page, depending on your browser and the referring site's settings.

Review filters run in your browser. Their selected values can appear in the page URL so you can share the same search. We do not send them to a separate search or analytics service, but a requested URL can be included in hosting logs. Avoid entering personal or sensitive information in a search box or shared URL.

sections.heading: Optional Google Analytics
paragraphs: If you choose Accept analytics, we load Google Analytics 4 to understand visits, traffic sources, page views, scrolling and outbound link use. Google receives browser and device information and request data, and analytics cookies such as _ga can distinguish visits. We do not load the Google Analytics tag or send analytics events before you accept. Rejecting analytics does not prevent you from reading the site.

Our implementation keeps advertising storage, advertising user data and ad personalization consent denied. Google signals and advertising personalization are disabled in the website tag. Page-view URLs omit query strings and fragments. Do not put personal or sensitive information in site URLs or search fields.

Use Cookie settings in the footer to change your choice. Reject analytics stops further measurement through this tag and removes its accessible first-party _ga cookies. Withdrawing consent does not automatically delete information already processed by Google. If your browser blocks local storage, your choice applies only to the current page.

links.label: How Google uses information from sites or apps that use its services

sections.heading: Hosting, fonts and external services
paragraphs: Cloudflare Pages hosts and delivers RC Car King. Depending on the security features in use and the request, Cloudflare may use necessary security cookies or challenges.

Our pages request fonts from Google Fonts. Your browser contacts Google's font servers, which receive information needed to handle the request, such as your IP address and request headers. The site does not embed YouTube players or other social-media widgets.

The services above may process information outside your country. Their processing, retention and transfer arrangements are described in their own privacy information. We do not claim that all service-provider logs are deleted after a particular number of days.

sections.heading: Amazon and other outbound links
paragraphs: As an Amazon Associate I earn from qualifying purchases. Our Amazon links include an affiliate identifier that lets Amazon attribute a qualifying purchase to this publication. Following one takes you to Amazon, where Amazon's cookies, privacy policy and purchase terms apply. RC Car King does not receive your payment details or your Amazon account credentials.

The price and availability display reads a public offer file from this website. Amazon product checks are performed separately during publication; your browser does not receive our API credentials or contact the Amazon product API to load that file.
Links to manufacturers, independent coverage and Coffeedant take you to separate websites. Their data practices apply when you visit them.

sections.heading: Messages and privacy requests
paragraphs: For a question, correction or privacy request, use the founder's existing contact page at Coffeedant and state that your message concerns RC Car King. That is an external website with its own form and privacy practices, rather than a form hosted on RC Car King.

Information you choose to send, such as your name, reply address, message and relevant page URL, is used to answer your request and keep an appropriate record of the correspondence. Please do not send payment details, passwords or other sensitive information. Correspondence is kept as needed to address the request and any applicable recordkeeping obligations.

sections.heading: Your choices and applicable rights
paragraphs: You can manage cookies and external requests through your browser settings and extensions. Blocking external fonts may change the typeface without preventing you from reading the reviews. You can choose not to follow affiliate or other external links.

Depending on the law that applies to you, you may have rights to request access to, correction of, deletion of or a restriction on the use of personal information, or to object to particular processing. Contact the publisher with enough context to identify your request; we may need to verify it before responding. You may also have the right to contact your local data protection authority.

sections.heading: Children and policy updates
paragraphs: We do not knowingly ask children to provide personal information. If you believe a child has supplied personal information in correspondence concerning RC Car King, contact the publisher so the situation can be reviewed.

We will update this page when the site's data practices change. The date above identifies this version. New features that collect visitor information will need corresponding privacy information before they are introduced.

pages.title: Terms of Service | RC Car King
pages.heading: Terms of Service
pages.description: Terms for using RC Car King's research-led reviews, editorial ratings, affiliate links and credited media, including purchase responsibilities and corrections.
pages.intro: These terms describe use of RC Car King, the RC vehicle review publication run by Aleksandar Spasevski. By using the website, you agree to these terms to the extent permitted by applicable law.

sections.heading: What the website provides
paragraphs: RC Car King publishes research-led RC vehicle reviews and buying guides. Current reviews use manufacturer documentation, exact product checks and attributed independent sources. AI assists research organization and drafting. A review does not claim our own hands-on driving experience unless it explicitly provides that evidence.

Editorial ratings assess a documented buying package for a stated audience. They are not Amazon customer ratings, independent safety certifications or guarantees of speed, runtime, durability or performance. Read the review's evidence, dates and methodology before relying on a recommendation.

sections.heading: Prices, affiliate links and purchases
paragraphs: As an Amazon Associate I earn from qualifying purchases. Purchases through our affiliate links may earn a commission at no extra cost to you. We identify affiliate links and keep the editorial score separate from commercial offers.

RC Car King is a publication, not the seller of the vehicles it reviews. Purchases, payment, shipping, warranties and returns are handled by the retailer under that retailer's terms. Confirm the exact model, variant, included equipment and seller before ordering.

Reference prices, specifications, seller information and availability can change. Amazon-supplied data is provided as is and can change or be removed. Our offer display stops showing commercial data after its freshness window, but a displayed price still does not bind the retailer. The retailer's listing and checkout determine the actual purchase terms.

sections.heading: Use RC equipment responsibly
paragraphs: Buying guides do not replace the manufacturer's manual, battery and charger instructions, supervision requirements or local rules. Follow the instructions for your exact vehicle and power equipment, and choose a suitable permitted location away from people, traffic and hazards.

You are responsible for checking compatibility, age guidance, protective measures and the rules that apply where you operate the vehicle. Seek qualified help when you are unsure about repairs, charging or modifications.

sections.heading: Content, images and attribution
paragraphs: Original editorial text, site design and original artwork belong to their respective rights holders. Manufacturer photographs, manuals, logos and trademarks remain the property of their owners and are credited where used. Their presence does not imply endorsement of RC Car King.

You may link to our public pages and use content as permitted by applicable law. Republishing full reviews, distributing copies of credited third-party media or using our branding commercially requires the relevant rights holder's permission. The sitemap and llms.txt help readers and tools find content; they do not grant an additional license.

sections.heading: Acceptable use and external websites
paragraphs: Do not use the site unlawfully, impersonate the publisher, try to gain unauthorized access, introduce malicious code or interfere with availability. Automated readers should respect robots.txt, reasonable request rates and the rights attached to the content.

External links are provided for evidence, context or shopping. We do not control those websites, their availability or their terms. Review the policies of any external service you use. Our Privacy Policy explains the current services used to deliver this site.

sections.heading: Accuracy, availability and legal rights
paragraphs: We aim to publish useful, accurate information, but sources can contain errors and products can change after a review is checked. The website and its information are provided as available, without a promise of uninterrupted service or a guarantee that every detail is complete or current.

To the extent permitted by applicable law, the publisher is not responsible for loss arising from reliance on the site's information, the use of an external website or a purchase made from a third-party retailer. Nothing in these terms excludes liability that cannot lawfully be excluded or limits mandatory consumer rights.

sections.heading: Corrections, questions and changes
paragraphs: Send corrections, rights questions or questions about these terms through the founder's existing Coffeedant contact page. State that your message concerns RC Car King and include the relevant page URL and supporting details.
These terms may be updated as the publication changes. The date above identifies the current version. Our About page and review methodology explain the publication's identity and editorial standards.
